Description: During Harry Thornton’s time alone in the Kitchen, a sudden abnormal incident occurs. After he mutters under his breath, thunder follows, along with crockery shattering and a heavy object falling, and then the Kitchen falls into silence.
Location: Kitchen (Kitchen)
Key Information:
  - Harry Thornton is alone in the Kitchen (Kitchen).
  - Footsteps and chaotic noises can be heard pacing back and forth on the floor directly above the Kitchen.
  - Harry Thornton, speaking to himself, mentions “He really is dead,” indicating he has confirmed the death as fact.
  - After thunder, the Kitchen is followed by the sound of dishes shattering and then a heavy object falling.
  - After these sounds end, there is no further activity or sound in the Kitchen.
  - The recorder explicitly labels this node as the start of “Act II” of the story.
Characters:
  [Harry Thornton (Harry Thornton)] Person No. 11, the butler of the Galley Villa.
    · Is confirmed to be alone in the Kitchen in this node.
    · Expresses an emotional reaction to the death incident in the form of muttering to himself.
    · Is the only confirmed person present when the abnormal sounds occur.
